Title: Product Engineer, AI (Junior to Mid-Level)
Location: Zürich
Visa: 
About us At PastaHR, we're building the Agentic AI platform for enterprise recruiting teams. Recruiters are drowning in applications, repetitive tasks, and manual processes. Meanwhile, agentic AI adoption in enterprise recruiting is still in its infancy. We're here to change that. Our platform integrates with existing applicant tracking systems like Workday and SAP, bringing AI-powered screening, scheduling, and custom AI agents into the workflows recruiters already use. While other recruiting startups sell to startups, we bring AI into the real world. We serve enterprise customers across industries like retail, manufacturing, construction, logistics or financial services including companies like Aldi, Siemens, Swisscom or Vontobel. We're a small, ambitious team with big goals. Our team brings together people with strong backgrounds in technology, startups, and entrepreneurship. As a bootstrapped company, we grow through real commercial success. That means we're resourceful, move fast, and achieve a lot with a lean team.
